script_text: Your ruling planet Saturn is about to shake your entire world this Capricorn week. Early week, Monday through Wednesday, brings a powerful conjunction between Mercury in your 10th House of career and Mars in your 6th House of daily work — expect intense responsibilities and a major assignment that demands your signature discipline. Tuesday is your worst day because Pallas squares Venus, creating tension in your love life, so avoid difficult conversations with your partner or crush. Wednesday marks the mid-week turning point as Jupiter moves into your 3rd House, and suddenly your ideas flow like never before. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun forms a trine with Venus, bringing a beautiful harmony that transforms your connections. Thursday afternoon brings an unforgettable romantic spark — be open to love in unexpected places. Friday and Saturday glow with creative energy and financial clarity, while Sunday offers a reflective calm perfect for planning your path ahead. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter enters your 3rd House and unlocks your communication superpower. Saturday is your worst day because Neptune clouds your judgment — sign nothing binding. This week, write down every idea that comes to you — Saturn rewards the documented thought. Follow for daily updates.
